title: Number theory benchmark expansion
objective: Add a real-domain number theory benchmark slice while preserving independent verification and replay evidence.

in_scope: M7 number theory proofs, negative corpus and CI replay

deliverables.name: Number theory benchmark
deliverables.acceptance: Add five versioned number theory cases with positive and negative mappings.

deliverables.name: Independent verifier
deliverables.acceptance: Validate manifest-to-source mappings and registered data paths without theorem policy.

deliverables.name: Negative replay
deliverables.acceptance: Reject altered number theory manifests and proof sources in temporary fixtures.

deliverables.name: Evidence binding
deliverables.acceptance: Bind M7 evidence to M6 readiness and the locked Lean toolchain.

deliverables.name: Readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable M7 readiness report.
